name: Mitten Extracts Disposable | Papaya Kush
description: Tropical sweetness with a mellow, grounded finish—Papaya Kush is a fruity indica that brings the island vibes straight to your session. Smooth and flavorful, this 2g disposable delivers juicy papaya notes wrapped in calming effects that wash over you in waves. Perfect for escaping the stress of the day, it’s a mini-vacation in every hit.
